data.title: Bußgeldbescheid: €87.00 fine for a parking violation on 10 October 2026
data.summary: The Bußgeldstelle (fine office) of Stadt Musterquellen issued a notice (Bußgeldbescheid, Az. OA-VÜ 26.501234) imposing a total fine of €87.00 on Bastian Musterquell for stopping in a no-stopping zone on Bahnhofstraße on 10 October 2026, obstructing a bus. The notice was delivered on 21 November 2026 and can be objected to (Einspruch) within two weeks of delivery; payment is due only after the notice becomes final.
data.explanation: This is an official fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) for a parking offense. You can decide whether to accept the fine or object (Einspruch) to it; the app will show the deadline for that decision, computed from the delivery date on the attached delivery certificate (Zustellungsurkunde). If you do nothing by then, the notice becomes final (rechtskräftig) and you must pay the €87.00 total within two weeks after that point to the IBAN shown — do not pay before it becomes final. If you believe the fine is wrong, consider objecting in writing before the deadline; for complex cases a lawyer or traffic-law advice service (Verkehrsrechtsschutz) can help. Ignoring a final notice can lead to enforcement.
